items.title_en: Boehringer, Zealand's obesity drug did not raise heart risks in trial, data shows

brief_points.en: The update centers on clinical development or trial data.
brief_points.zh: 这条新闻核心涉及临床开发或试验数据。

brief_points.en: The key questions are endpoint quality, patient selection and the next readout.
brief_points.zh: 关键问题是终点质量、患者选择以及下一次数据公布。

brief_points.en: What matters next is whether the signal can be reproduced or translated into development value.

items.summary_en: Today's update centers on: Boehringer, Zealand's obesity drug did not raise heart risks in trial, data shows
items.summary_zh: 先理解新闻事实，再从研发、监管、商业与竞争格局判断影响。
items.expert_analysis: 专家会重点看试验设计、终点、患者分层、时间线与后续数据，而不是只判断“成功或失败”。对行业学习者来说，要把临床证据与资产价值联系起来。
